# docker_registry_manifest_list

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Pushes a multi-platform image index (OCI image index or Docker manifest list) under a tag, assembled from images that are already in the same registry, like `docker manifest create` + `annotate` + `push` or `docker buildx imagetools create`. Everything goes through the registry v2 HTTP API with the provider's `registry_auth`; nothing is pulled and the daemon is not involved. Images from other repositories of the registry are copied in by cross-repository blob mount. The index is a Docker manifest list when every entry is a Docker schema 2 manifest and no annotations are set, otherwise an OCI image index. A change to the entries pushes a new index under the same tag (in place); destroy deletes the index unless `keep_remotely = true`.

## Example

```terraform
# Two single-platform images already pushed to the registry ...
resource "docker_registry_image" "amd64" {
  name = "registry.example.com/team/app:1.0-amd64"
}

resource "docker_registry_image" "arm64" {
  name = "registry.example.com/team/app:1.0-arm64"
}

# ... combined into one multi-platform tag (docker manifest create + push).
resource "docker_registry_manifest_list" "app" {
  name = "registry.example.com/team/app:1.0"

  manifests = [
    { image = docker_registry_image.amd64.image_digest_ref },
    {
      image   = docker_registry_image.arm64.image_digest_ref
      variant = "v8" # docker manifest annotate --variant v8
    },
  ]

  annotations = {
    "org.opencontainers.image.source" = "https://github.com/team/app"
  }
}

output "app_index" {
  value = docker_registry_manifest_list.app.image_digest_ref
}
```

## Import

```shell
# Import by the tag the index is pushed under. The entries are read back as
# digest references (<registry>/<repository>@sha256:...), without overrides.
terraform import docker_registry_manifest_list.app registry.example.com/team/app:1.0
```
